description_en: Queries the list of pay-as-you-go bills
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-postpay-bills --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePostpayBills

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

When querying pay-as-you-go bills, StartTime and EndTime are required parameters. You must specify both to determine the query time range
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

查询后付费账单时，StartTime 和 EndTime 为必填参数，需同时指定以确定查询的时间范围
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

When querying pay-as-you-go bills, StartTime and EndTime are required parameters. You must specify both to determine the query time range
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

查询后付费账单时，StartTime 和 EndTime 为必填参数，需同时指定以确定查询的时间范围
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token for the next page. If a next page exists, this field has a return value.

If this parameter has a return value, a next page exists. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the data on the next page. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
下一页查询凭证（Token），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。

该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The statistical period type of the bill
parameters.name: period_type
